news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. No experienced directors. 5 highly experienced directors. Independent Non-Executive Director Sarada Dittakavi was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2012. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Kolli Murali Krishna and Gogineni Srinivas agreed to acquire 62.90% stake in Senthil Infotek Limited (BSE:531980) from Pitchandi Chellamani, Pitchandi Seetha Lakshmi, Pitchandi Selvam, Pitchandi Anuradha, Pitchandi Malliga and Cementeel Constructions Pvt Ltd for INR 25.41 million.
